propositions: Retire hand-rolled argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py in favor of stdlib argparse while preserving all existing CLI observable behavior

Preserve load-bearing None-vs-empty-string distinctions: --assignee absent yields None (fallback), explicit --assignee "" clears value; --force bare yields force_reason="" (only None when absent), never consuming following token

Maintain command-specific --force semantics: claim bare --force consumes next non-option token as reason or defaults to '(no reason given)'; transition bare --force sets force_reason="" without token consumption
Retire --force-close flag with explicit exit-1 rejection and bespoke error message; unknown/extra tokens silently skipped; prefix abbreviation disabled (allow_abbrev=False)

Retain transition._parse_flags as argparse-backed shim returning identical 5-tuple for three external direct callers in tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_close_ref_target_80af.py, tests/unit/test_transition_force_flag_24f7.py, tests/scripts/test_dependency_audit.py

Ensure --help remains byte-exact dispatcher-served golden text (help/claim.txt, help/transition.txt); argparse parser has add_help=False; maintain exit code 10 on ConcurrencyError and exit code 1 on validation errors
